## Evaluation setup
- Hold-out: train = first 80% = 13903 h (2011-01-01 00:00 to 2012-08-07 11:00); test = last 20% = 3476 h (2012-08-07 12:00 to 2012-12-31 23:00)
- Time-series CV: 5 expanding-window folds on the training period only:

|   Fold |   Train hours | Months in validation unseen in training   | Train period             |   Validation hours | Validation period        |
|-------:|--------------:|:------------------------------------------|:-------------------------|-------------------:|:-------------------------|
|      1 |          2318 | 5, 6, 7                                   | 2011-01-01 to 2011-04-11 |               2317 | 2011-04-11 to 2011-07-17 |
|      2 |          4635 | 8, 9, 10                                  | 2011-01-01 to 2011-07-17 |               2317 | 2011-07-17 to 2011-10-22 |
|      3 |          6952 | 11, 12                                    | 2011-01-01 to 2011-10-22 |               2317 | 2011-10-22 to 2012-01-27 |
|      4 |          9269 | none                                      | 2011-01-01 to 2012-01-27 |               2317 | 2012-01-27 to 2012-05-02 |
|      5 |         11586 | none                                      | 2011-01-01 to 2012-05-02 |               2317 | 2012-05-02 to 2012-08-07 |

- Metrics: MAE, RMSE, R^2 (scikit-learn); negative predictions clipped to 0
- Seasonal naive used a fallback (day-before or last value) for 39 of 3476 test hours because the week-earlier hour is missing

## Model inputs after each model's own transformation
- Linear Regression: 53 columns (one-hot season/mnth/hr/weekday/weathersit with first level dropped; temp/atemp/hum/windspeed standardized; yr/holiday/workingday as 0/1)
- SVR: 18 columns (sin/cos of hr, mnth, weekday; one-hot season; all standardized); target standardized, predictions converted back to bikes
- Random Forest: 12 raw columns, no scaling
- Hyperparameters: scikit-learn defaults for all three (LinearRegression(); SVR kernel=rbf, C=1.0, epsilon=0.1, gamma=scale; RandomForestRegressor n_estimators=100, random_state=42)

## Hold-out results (Table 2)

| Model             |   MAE |   RMSE |     R2 |   Fit+predict time (s) |
|:------------------|------:|-------:|-------:|-----------------------:|
| Seasonal naive    | 65.01 | 112.18 | 0.7411 |                   0.05 |
| Linear Regression | 98.69 | 133.82 | 0.6316 |                   0.06 |
| SVR (RBF)         | 75.53 | 127.09 | 0.6678 |                   5.94 |
| Random Forest     | 44.99 |  69.56 | 0.9005 |                   1.93 |

- Random Forest MAE vs Linear Regression: 54.4% lower
- Random Forest MAE vs SVR: 40.4% lower
- Random Forest MAE vs Seasonal naive: 30.8% lower
